lines: Rajesh Kesavan Nambisan, Other Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds because they sell 2,136,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹70.49 crore are scheduled on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares worth up to ₹81.07 crore (estimate at offer price) stay locked in for 6 months from allotment, so more money follows later.
Caveat: the average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents, so the gain cannot be stated.
